findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion that the failed slice lowers the converged fraction is arithmetic rather than evidence: measure.py:487-488 computes with_failed_fraction as converged/(n+1) and normal_fraction as converged/n from the same numerator, so the inequality holds whether or not the displaced zero-budget slice failed, and only the converged==[False] assertion on verify.py:84 actually tests the control.

non-blocking: the gate counts only `Compiling jit(solve)` and never asserts the receipt's post_first_compilations, so it stays green under the 20 helper compilations the receipt and the fragment both record; the done-when clause "zero new compilations after the first slice" is reported in prose but not measured by the gate.

non-blocking: the first non-zero arm raises and aborts the arm loop, so the width-16 arm ran one process rather than the two fresh processes the brief requires, leaving the width-16 result a single observed refusal rather than a replicated one.
non-blocking: the module re-implements the timing and compilation accounting that scripts/prototypes/bank_h200_slice_profile/measure.py owns (compile_program, timed, closure) instead of importing it.

item_verdicts.diff: read all ten commits 2369edca..a3cae5e86 one by one; they add seven prototype modules, one fragment and 22 figure artifacts, and the later commits correct real defects (false X-point from conflating boundary contact with the tracked saddle at d00e5417, failed slices missing from the contact sheet at 13576e2b).
item_verdicts.done_when: read the three done-when clauses; clause 3 is fully delivered (docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/dina-flattop-scenario.html plus 20 SVG panels and a 20-frame GIF), clause 2 is half delivered (width-1 walls and both negative controls present; width-16 throughput absent, unmeasured not zero), and clause 1's 90%-and-zero-recompiles measures are observed to fail at 16/20 and 20 recompilations, which the gate does not assert.
item_verdicts.goal: read the node goal (run the DINA 105027 flattop on the ITER bank route on the H200 in time order, each slice warm-started from the previous); scripts/prototypes/dina_flattop_scenario/measure.py:472-480 does seed each slice from the previous result, and the retained receipt shows indices 129-148 consecutive, but the quantitative arms (90% convergence, zero post-first compilations, width-16 throughput) are unmet and recorded as measured.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md and manifest.md.asdelivered; it states 16/20 converged, 20 post-first compilations, the 216.76 GiB width-16 refusal and blockers naming the unmet numerical clauses rather than claiming success, and its tests line names the artifact gate whose result I reproduced below.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths and the full diff base 8907e8648..head a3cae5e86; all 30 changed files sit under scripts/prototypes/dina_flattop_scenario/, docs/evidence/fragments/sub-millisecond-forward-path/dina-flattop-scenario.html and docs/figures/sub-millisecond-forward-path/dina-flattop-scenario/, with no product source touched.

justifications.durability: verify.py:38-41 reddens if any slice claims convergence above 1e-10, which I confirmed by running its own --mutate_failure path, so a false convergence is refused.
justifications.evidence: I re-ran the named gate at the reviewed head (EXIT=0, ARTIFACTS_VERIFIED slices=20 converged=16 svg=20 gif_frames=20 false_convergence_refused=True) against the retained receipts, but verify.py:72-73 asserts only that jit(solve) compiles once, so the gate cannot measure the done-when's zero-recompilation clause it reports at verify.py:78-90.
justifications.fit: `ruff check` on the added modules is clean and the modules follow the surrounding prototype idiom, e.g. scripts/prototypes/dina_flattop_scenario/measure.py:36-44 mirrors the logging-handler style of scripts/prototypes/bank_h200_slice_profile/measure.py:87-89.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/dina_flattop_scenario/measure.py:472-480 chains a genuine warm start across all twenty slices, but the 90%-converged, zero-recompile and width-16 clauses the node was dispatched for are unmet at 16/20 and 20 recompilations.
justifications.reuse: render.py:19-28 extends the owners it consumes (nova.media painters, iter_bank.render.checked_save), while scripts/prototypes/dina_flattop_scenario/measure.py:36-44 and 355-366 re-implement the compile-and-timing accounting that scripts/prototypes/bank_h200_slice_profile/measure.py:87-129 owns.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in `git diff --stat 8907e8648 a3cae5e86` lies inside the three declared write paths, and no file outside them changed.
